name: n4_spy_page
description: Read one diagnostics page of the station's spy tree (GET /ord?spy:/<path>, the pages the Workbench Spy view shows) as data: title, tables (title, header, rows of cells), links to child pages as relative spy paths, the POST actions the page offers (named only as spy paths without their query, never invoked) and the text outside tables. The content of a form field (textarea, select, button, input) is never returned, wherever it sits. Read-only: one GET under the spy root. Refused before any request: a scheme or ':' (except one module:Type segment directly under sysManagers/registryManager/types/, the registry's type pages, e.g. sysManagers/registryManager/types/control:NumericWritable), '|', '..', a query string ('?', '&', '=', '#'), '%', ';', a backslash, any Unicode control character, invalid UTF-8 and the known action pages (util/gc, util/forceThreadDump). status is ok, forbidden (the user may not read spy pages), not_found, not_html or parse_timeout (the page was not parsed within timeout_s). Spy pages are diagnostics: their layout differs between Niagara versions, so read the tables as found. The reply is bounded as a whole: truncated is true when a cap cut it and truncated_by names the caps (max_bytes, max_rows across all tables, tables, row_cells, links, actions, name, cell, text).

path.description: Path below the spy root, e.g. metrics, sysInfo or util/JMX Info; empty for the index

max_rows.description: Cap of table rows returned, all tables together

max_bytes.description: Byte cap of the page read
